messages:
hannah: Heads up — planning an unpin of runtime v3.2 from canary at 10:45 UTC unless we hit signals. Need ops + SDK check.

michael: Any known regressions? last canary showed a small tail latency bump on longseqs.

dina: Noted. Also need release notes callout for KV-cache invalidation flag change. I can update PR once we lock the window.

sre-jen: Observability: there's a heatmap alert that fired 3x this morning in eu-west-1. Recommend a 15m grace drain and an extra telemetry slice for the first 5000 requests.

hannah: Proposal: extend deploybot grace period to 15m and schedule unpin at 10:45 -> with drain target label canary-eu. If any latency > 200ms P95 or error-rate > 0.5% rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: automated: scheduled unpin request received -> runtime=v3.2 env=canary when=2024-02-15T10:45:00Z grace=900s meta="canary-eu".

michael: +1 on grace. Also add fallback routing to runtime v3.1 for requests with tag prefer-stable.

dina: I'll open a tiny release-note blurb and link. PR: https://git.internal/rn/4567 — includes note about changed k/v cache semantics and recommended prompt-caching.

hannah: runbook snippet for oncall: 
```
1) watch /canary/latency and /canary/errors for 20m
2) if P95 > 200ms -> pause unpin + revert routing
3) if errors spike > 0.5% -> rollback to v3.1 via deploy-bot rollback token
```

rollout-bot: check: eu-west-1 telemetry slice created -> slice_id=eu-canary-20240215-01.

sre-jen: I pulled a flamegraph of the earlier run, looks like a kernel scheduling edge on the fused-attn path. If we see CPU steal > 10% on the GPU host, abort.

hannah: ok we set abort signals: cpu_steal > 10%, p95 > 200ms, errors > 0.5%. deploy-bot please hold and notify if any abort trigger before the scheduled time.

deploy-bot: acknowledged: will hold/unhold per signals and send final confirmation 5m before scheduled time.

michael: One more: SDK compat check — v2.7 clients have a shim for the new kernel, but older pinned SDKs might hit header mismatch. Add a warning to the CI gating that blocks unpin if >1% of requests come from sdk<=2.6.

dina: Added gating note to PR 4567 and pinged platform-sdks to advertise.

hannah: final: grace=15m, fallback=v3.1 routing set, abort signals in runbook, release-note PR linked. Plan to proceed unless any new red signals. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: update: unpin deferred by 30m due to ongoing heatmap alerts in eu-west-1. New tentative unpin: 2024-02-15T11:15:00Z.

hannah: thanks — pushing target and will re-check telemetry at +10m. Oncall: @sre-jen please take lead for the 11:15 attempt.

sre-jen: onit. I'll post a quick summary after the 11:15 run.

michael: LGTM. If we still see noise at 11:15 we should consider a scoped canary (10% traffic) instead of full canary.

dina: PR 4567 updated with final note and SDK caveat.

hannah: closing for now — will reopen thread with final deploy-bot confirmation after the 11:15 attempt.
